description: Pantheon fork harness — hooks + permissions enforcing Foundation sub-project rules

hooks.prompt: Check the pending Bash command. If it contains any of `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `git branch -D`, `rm -rf /opt`, or attempts to write to `/home/admin-linux/sandbox/valeria-standalone/` or `systemd/valeria-sandbox.service`, REFUSE and tell the operator why. Otherwise approve.
If the file just edited has extension .ts or .tsx, remind Claude to run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` on the changed file's package. Otherwise, no action.

At session start: (1) read ~/.claude/projects/--wsl-localhost-Ubuntu-opt-obsidian-pantheon/memory/MEMORY.md if it exists, (2) list the 3 most recent files in /opt/pantheon/src/docs/retros/ if the directory exists, (3) summarize active tasks. Keep under 200 words.

Before context compaction: (1) note current git branch and any uncommitted changes via `git status --short`, (2) list active tasks from TaskList, (3) summarize key decisions from this session in 3-5 bullets. This summary survives compaction.

If this session made 5+ tool calls or touched 3+ files, draft a one-paragraph auto-retro summarizing: what was done, what surprised you, what the next session should check first. Offer to save it to /opt/pantheon/src/docs/retros/YYYY-MM-DD-{topic-slug}.md via the `remember` skill. Don't save unless operator confirms.
